title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

reports.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
Stanford R&DE Uses AI to Race Swap Students for Advertising
University confirms use of AI-edited photo amid controversy
Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

summary:
Stanford Residential & Dining Enterprises altered student photos in advertisements using artificial intelligence. Student Billy Ramirez, class of 2027, noticed that a photo taken of him on campus had been changed, he was removed and replaced with an AI generated Black woman. Two other students beside him were also digitally slimmed down and had their faces altered. Ramirez said he was baffled and upset, feeling silenced and erased because Stanford made choices about his representation without his consent.

The incident drew thousands of reactions on the social platform Fizz. The Stanford Review says it will continue to monitor future advertising and actions from Stanford R&DE as the department learns to use generative AI. No further response from Stanford R&DE was mentioned in the article.
